items.summary: Unauthenticated authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and ISE-PIC API endpoints. Actively exploited in the wild — attackers can bypass the web management login and gain root-level command execution; CISA added it to the KEV catalog.

Path traversal in the GitLab repository commits API lets an unauthenticated attacker read arbitrary server files (configs, secrets, SSH keys) when at least one public project exists. Under active in-the-wild exploitation and CISA KEV-listed.

SQL injection in the email-parsing logic of Cisco AsyncOS for Secure Email Gateway. A single crafted email lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute arbitrary commands as root; Cisco PSIRT confirmed active exploitation and CISA KEV-listed it.

Unauthenticated remote code execution in Orkes Conductor (versions 3.21.21 to 3.30.2) via insecurely configured GraalVM expression evaluators — crafted workflow definitions execute OS commands before authentication is enforced. Fortinet reports active exploitation in the wild.

RCE in Gitea's diffpatch endpoint lets an attacker with repository write access install malicious Git hooks and run commands as the Gitea user (open registration makes this trivially reachable). Now weaponized by the 'Red Heron' espionage campaign that compromised 13 organizations across six countries.
